text_1981: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
text_1989: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
text_ref: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.

text_1981: When the sky shatters.
text_1989: When the heaven is shattered.
text_ref: When the heaven is shattered.

text_1981: And the planets disperse.
text_1989: The planets are scattered.
text_ref: The planets are scattered.

text_1981: And the oceans explode.
text_1989: The oceans are exploded.
text_ref: The oceans are exploded.

text_1981: And the graves are opened. 5.
text_1989: The graves are opened.
text_ref: The graves are opened.

text_1981: Every soul will find out what caused it to advance, and what caused it to regress.
text_1989: Every soul will find out what caused it to advance, and what caused it to regress.
text_ref: Every soul will find out what caused it to advance, and what caused it to regress.

subtitle: Reflect on God's Creations
text_1981: O human being, what diverted you from your honorable Lord?
text_1989: O you human being, what diverted yc from your Lord, Most Honorable?
text_ref: O you human being, what diverted you from your Lord, Most Honorable?

text_1981: He created you, designed you, and perfected you.
text_1989: The One who created you, designed you, and .perfected you.
text_ref: The One who created you, designed you, and perfected you.

text_1981: In the shape that He chose, He constructed you.
text_1989: In whatever design He chose, He constructed you.
text_ref: In whatever design He chose, He constructed it.

text_1981: Indeed, you deny the judgment.
text_1989: Indeed, you disbelieve in the religion.
text_ref: Indeed, you disbelieve in the religion.

text_1981: Guards are assigned to protect you.
text_1989: Oblivious to the fact that there are (invisible) keepers around you.
text_ref: Oblivious to the fact that there are (invisible) keepers around you.

text_1981: They are honest recorders.
text_1989: They are honest recorders.
text_ref: They are honest recorders.

text_1981: They know everything you do.
text_1989: They record everything you do.
text_ref: They record everything you do.

text_1981: The righteous have deserved bliss.
text_1989: Surely, the pious have deserved bliss.
text_ref: Surely, the pious have deserved bliss.

text_1981: While the wicked have deserved hell. §
text_1989: While the wicked have deserved Hell
text_ref: While the wicked have deserved Hell.

text_1981: They will burn therein on the day of judgment.
text_1989: Will incur it on the Day of Judgment.
text_ref: Will incur it on the Day of Judgment.

text_1981: They can never evade it. Do you have any idea what the day of judgment is? Again, do you have any idea what the day of judgment is? That is the day when no soul will have any power to help another soul, and all decisions, on that day, will be made by God.
text_1989: They never leave it.
text_ref: They never leave it.

text_1981: Awesome is the Day of Judgment.
text_1989: Awesome is the Day of Judgment.
text_ref: Awesome is the Day of Judgment.

text_1981: What a day; the Day of Judgment!
text_1989: What a day; the Day of Judgment!
text_ref: What a day; the Day of Judgment!

text_1981: That is the day when no soul can help another soul, and all decisions, on that day, will belong to GOD.
text_1989: That is the day when no soul can help another soul, and all decisions, on that day, will belong to GOD.
text_ref: That is the day when no soul can help another soul, and all decisions, on that day, will belong to GOD.
